hits.title: Naïve Raises $28.5M in Series A Funding
hits.snippet: [](https://www.finsmes.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Naive.jpg) **[Naïve](https://usenaive.ai)** , a Palo Alto, CA-based provider of an infrastructure platform for AI agents, raised $28.5M in Series A funding. The round was led by Nexus Venture Partners with participation from Y Combinator, Zetta, Liquid 2, Gokul Rajaram, Tim Zheng, JD Sherman, Gert Lanckriet, Robert Chatwani, and Zachary Sim. The company intends to use the funds to advance frontier research across four core pillars: serverless runtimes, inference, memory, and multi-agent orchestration Founded by Sean Dorje and Dennis Zax, Naïve provides an API that empowers AI agents with real-world business needs, including legal incorporation, virtual cards, compute, memory, and multi-agent orchestration.
